sentReview: The initialization message has been sent. Review the conversation, then continue to the next step.
entryChooseWorkspace: Enter a workspace before using Chief.
entrySetupRequired: Open the workspace to finish setting up Chief and start its executor.
entryCheckFailed: Couldn't check Chief's status. Please try again.

configure.title: Configure Chief
configure.description: Finish Chief setup and bring the executor online before continuing.

open.title: Open Chief
open.description: Click the robot entry in the header. Chief opens in expanded mode automatically.

send.title: Send the initialization request
send.description: The prompt is filled in. Review it and click Send yourself; nothing is sent automatically.

handoff.title: Continue with Chief
handoff.description: Continue the workspace initialization with Chief; it will guide the remaining configuration.

substep.hostOs: Choose the OS of the computer or server running the executor
substep.copy: Copy the command and start it
substep.waitOnline: Wait for the Chief executor to come online

dialog.title: Disable future workspace guides?
dialog.body: This guide will no longer appear for this or any future workspace you create. You can still initialize a workspace through the Chief entry at the top of the platform.

setup.existingClient: An executor already exists; the current client is reused.
setup.chooseOs: Choose the OS of the computer or server running the executor
setup.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text above and copy it manually.
setup.copiedHint: Open a terminal on the computer or server running your executor, paste and run the command, and keep it running. Continue once Chief is online and ready.
setup.waiting: Waiting for the Chief executor to come online.
setup.autoCheckHint: The guide will advance automatically once the executor is online.
setup.waitExpired: The executor has not reported ready yet. Retry, check the command in the terminal, or skip for now.
setup.actionFailed: The action did not succeed. Retry; you stay on this step.

prompt.initial: Please initialize the current workspace and guide me through the configuration required for software delivery.

draftBlocked: An existing draft was left untouched. Send or clear it, then retry.
capabilityMissing: Workspace initialization is not available yet, so it cannot be handed off. Retry later.
sendFailed: Sending failed. Your draft is kept; retry when ready.
reserveFailed: Could not prepare the initialization conversation. Retry.
advanceFailed: Could not save the guide progress. Refresh and try again.
conflict: The guide progress changed and the latest state is shown.
skipFailed: Could not save the skip preference. Retry.
disableFailed: Saving the preference failed. Retry; the guide stays open.
prefReadFailed: Could not read the workspace guide preference, so the guide is hidden.
loadFailed: Could not load the workspace guide.
